features.intro: Control both patches in Mod settings inside Settings and privacy.
install.intro: You need the original TikTok Lite 47.8.15 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically.go, version code 470815). If that version is installed from Google Play, use it as the source in Morphe or export its split APKs. If Play offers a different version and you have no compatible original backup, wait for support for another version. GitHub distributes the .mpp patch bundle.

step.source.add: Choose Add to Morphe or add this source manually:
step.patch.apk: In Morphe Desktop, apply Hide feed ads to base.apk. In a separate run, apply the other two patches to split_df_edit_filter.apk.
step.open.install: Keep the split filenames and use the same package ID and certificate across the set. Full installation from Manager is still being tested.
install.settings: Open Settings and privacy → Mod settings to control the patches.
